free_tier.stated: 50 GB free — 'The free plan includes 50 GB of storage, up to 3 connected apps, and transfer speeds up to 524 Mbps — with no Siacoin to buy and no server to run.'

egress.terms: unmetered but rate-shaped by plan: 'transfer speeds up to 524 Mbps' on Free. No per-GB egress line item exists in Sia's model.

tooling: s3d gateway (github.com/SiaFoundation/s3d) exposes an S3-compatible API; docs name Rclone and Cyberduck explicitly. Python/Go/Rust/JS SDKs also exist. rclone has a native 'sia' backend (rclone.org/sia/).
chaining: 50 GB x unlimited accounts (signup is free, no Siacoin required). The plan gate is '3 connected apps' per account, and an app is a token — the same wrapper pattern as Google service accounts. 400 accounts = 20 TB, but each is a separate signup.
limits_note: per-object-cap: not stated on the pages read. request-rate / per-ip-shaping: 'transfer speeds up to 524 Mbps' is the explicit Free-plan throttle. retention: not stated; storage is contract-based, so retention is paid-for duration, not decaying.
reliability_note: New hosted product (app launched 2026); only paths offered on the free page are the iOS/Android app and the s3d gateway, so scripting depends entirely on s3d working.
